compute_cider_score: compute the CIDEr score for image caption hypotheses against reference captions using n-gram TF-IDF weighting
create_cider_scorer: create a CiderScorer instance to accumulate test and reference captions for batch CIDEr evaluation
cook_refs_precook_ngrams: precook reference sentences into n-gram term frequency vectors for CIDEr scoring
compute_doc_freq: compute document frequency of n-grams across all reference captions for inverse document frequency calculation
cook_test_precook_ngrams: precook a test hypothesis sentence into an n-gram term frequency vector for CIDEr comparison
